mapper.select: select teacher.id as teacherId, teacher.name as teacherName, course.id as courseId, course.title as courseTitle, course.lesson_num as courseLessonNum, course.status as courseStatus, course.view_count as courseViewCount, course.buy_count as courseBuyCount, course.cover as courseCover, course.price as coursePrice, course.create_time as courseCreateTime, course.update_time as courseUpdateTime, subject.id as subjectId, subject.title as subjectTitle, subject.sort as subjectSort, subject.create_time as subjectCreateTime, subject.update_time as subjectUpdateTime from edu_course course left join edu_teacher teacher on course.teacher_id = teacher.id left join edu_subject subject on course.subject_id = subject.id order by course.title, course.teacher_id, course.create_time

select c1.id as cid, c1.teacher_id as teacherId, c1.subject_id as subjectId, c1.title as title, c1.price as price, c1.lesson_num as lessonNum, c1.buy_count as buyCount, c1.view_count as viewCount, c1.version as version, c1.status as status, c1.is_deleted as isDeleted, c1.create_time as createTime, c1.update_time as updateTime, c2.id as ccid, c2.course_id as courseId, c2.title as ccTitle, c2.sort as ccSort, c2.create_time as ccCreateTime, c2.update_time as ccUpdateTime, c3.id as cccId, c3.chapter_id as chapterId, c3.title as cccTitle from edu_course c1 left join edu_chapter c2 on c1.id = c2.course_id left join edu_video c3 on c3.chapter_id = c2.id
